reason: For me, coming from a cousin who charges $600 a year, A does more to justify $199 a month: it spells out what the price covers (reconciled accounts, payroll taxes, a flat fee) and keeps the accountant-savings claim as a client's own words. B tells me about a recent price rise, which makes the cost feel bigger, and it states the $800 saving as fact when a client only reported it, though its invitation to talk about how I do my books now is warm.
